The right arm draws the gripped cube clear of the top shelf toward the right and starts moving it downward.
The right arm carries the cube down beside the shelf and inward over the bottom tray, lowering it onto the bottom level.
The right hand remains around the cube near the bottom surface during a small settling adjustment.
The right fingers open away from the cube, leaving it upright on the bottom shelf. The open right hand remains immediately beside it.
